productionAnswers: She tends to get upset when her plans are changed at the last minute.
She takes great care to ensure every detail of the project is perfect.

Thanks so much for stepping in; your support made all the difference.  
I’m truly grateful—not just for the assistance, but for how patiently and thoughtfully you guided me through it.
I treat myself to a fancy coffee every now and then to break up the routine.
This new electric car is surprisingly affordable, making it an attractive option for budget-conscious buyers.

There’s something deeply reassuring about her groundedness, especially in chaotic moments.
She excels in creative writing, whereas her brother has a natural talent for mathematics.

topErrorTags: 'tends to get upset' 语法正确，但对A2学习者而言略显复杂；'tends to' 属于B1及以上常用结构，A2更常使用简单现在时；'are changed' 是被动语态，A2阶段通常尚未掌握被动语态的熟练运用，建议改用主动表达或更基础句式。
'takes great care' 属于B1及以上常用搭配，对A2学习者而言过于正式且抽象；'ensure' 和 'perfect' 超出A2词汇大纲（CEFR A2词表不包含这两个词）；整句语法结构（不定式目的状语+被动语态'is perfect'）超出A2理解与产出能力。

未使用目标词 'free expression'；句子虽自然地道，但属于超出A2水平的复杂表达（如 'not just for... but for how patiently and thoughtfully you guided me...'），含高级连接结构和抽象副词，不符合A2学习者应掌握的语言范围；感谢语过度丰富，A2阶段更需聚焦基础功能表达（如 'thank you for helping me'）
句子语法正确，用词自然；'every now and then' 准确表达了‘偶尔、时不时’的频率含义，符合B1学习者对短语的掌握要求；整句结构清晰，动词时态（一般现在时）和搭配（treat oneself to...）均恰当。
句子语法正确，结构清晰；'affordable' 使用准确，符合B1水平对形容词表‘价格合理’的掌握要求；'budget-conscious buyers' 稍偏正式，但属可理解的常见搭配，未超出B1认知范围。
